paper.title: Physics-inspired transformer quantum states via latent imaginary-time evolution
paper.authors: Kimihiro Yamazaki, Itsushi Sakata, Takuya Konishi, Yoshinobu Kawahara

results.system_description: J₁–J₂ Heisenberg, 10 × 10 · J₂/J₁ = 0.5 · periodic · Sz = 0. H = J1 sum_<ij> S_i · S_j + J2 sum_<<ij>> S_i · S_j; spin-1/2 operators S = sigma/2; J1 = 1; J2 = 0.5; no constant shift
results.variant: Strang scheme, d = 108, n_h = 18, L = 8, Delta tau = 0.5
results.source_location: Main text, last paragraph of Numerical Results ("the Strang ansatz achieves an energy of E ≈ -0.49741(3)")
results.eligibility_evidence: Energy per site of the optimized transformer state evaluated by VMC, the best of five random seeds; the seed-averaged supplement tables and the literature values quoted in the text are excluded.
results.notes: Spin-1/2 operators, 10 x 10 lattice with periodic boundaries, J2/J1 = 0.5 (Numerical Results). The magnetization sector is not stated. Printed with "≈"; 10,000 iterations with 8,192 samples per iteration.

results.system_description: Hubbard, 4 × 4 · U/t = 4 · periodic · half filling (16 electrons). H = -t sum_<ij>,s (c†_is c_js + h.c.) + U sum_i n_iup n_idown; t = 1
results.variant: fermionic TQS with multi-Slater backflow decoder
results.source_location: Supplemental Material, Sec. 'Benchmark for Hubbard models', Table tab:hubbard, row TQS, column E (U/t = 4)
results.eligibility_evidence: Energy per site of the optimized transformer state evaluated by VMC, the best final energy of independent runs (Experimental Details); the ED row of the same table is a reference.
results.notes: 4 x 4 lattice at half filling with periodic boundary conditions (Table tab:hubbard caption and Eq. eq:hubbard). The spin sector is not stated; the ground state is a singlet (Nup = Ndown = 8). Above the exact-diagonalization energy printed in the same table.
